subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult East Asian woman in <Picture 1>. <Picture 1> is authoritative for her facial identity, long voluminous black hair, slim natural body proportions, loose beige knitted sweater with broad pale-blue horizontal bands, fitted black shorts, and brown lace-up combat boots. Her identity, hair, body proportions, and complete outfit remain unchanged in every location.
<Subject 2> is the stylized photorealistic three-dimensional world-map environment from <Video 1>, combining satellite-like terrain, extruded city buildings, recognizable landmarks, a clean floating search bar, a compact place-information card, and a red map pin. The interface contains only the city names 上海, 伦敦, 纽约, and 东京, with no brand logo or watermark.
<Video 1> is the whole-video narrative and transition reference, defining the opening phone interaction, map-pin trigger, rapid pull-back into a three-dimensional map, giant-character city tableaux, the Shanghai-to-London-to-New-York-to-Tokyo order, fast map-flight transitions, foreground building wipes, motion blur, speed ramps, and final stabilization. The original performer, her facial identity, hairstyle, wardrobe, subtitles, logos, and watermarks are excluded.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> opening a map on her phone and being carried through <Subject 2> in a 12-second travel montage. It follows the trigger, city order, scale contrast, camera path, transition rhythm, and final landing of <Video 1>, while preserving <Subject 1> as the same woman in the same outfit throughout.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - her face, long black hair, body proportions, beige-and-pale-blue sweater, black shorts, and brown lace-up boots remain stable across every map transition.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): partially_preserved - the map pin, three-dimensional city model, floating search bar, place card, landmarks, map-flight perspective, and interface logic are retained, while branding and unrelated labels are removed.
<Video 1> (used in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): partially_preserved - its opening trigger, Shanghai-to-London-to-New-York-to-Tokyo progression, giant-character staging, speed-ramped push-pull movement, directional blur, foreground wipes, and final steady landing are retained; the source performer and wardrobe are replaced by <Subject 1>.

detailed_description:
The video uses playful photorealistic compositing: <Subject 1> remains lifelike and sharply identifiable, while each city appears as a convincing three-dimensional map model with physical depth, atmospheric perspective, contact shadows, and consistent daylight. Maintain stable facial identity, hair length, body anatomy, clothing construction, and screen direction through every acceleration. Do not use dissolves or liquid morphing; every change is motivated by the red pin, a camera speed ramp, or a foreground building wipe.

[Shot 1] From 00:00.000, a full-body view shows <Subject 1> standing alone in a clean white infinite space, holding a smartphone with both hands at chest height. Her long black hair hangs naturally over the beige-and-pale-blue sweater, and her black shorts and brown boots are fully readable. She taps the screen, glances up at the camera, and says in a clear, lightly playful young adult female voice, <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 让我们先打开地图。</d> At 00:01.500, a small red map pin materializes directly above her head, drops along a straight path, and stops in the air without touching her. It pulses once with a soft digital ping. She raises her eyes toward it while keeping the phone steady.

At 00:02.500, the pin enlarges rapidly toward the lens and briefly covers the center of the frame. Behind this red occlusion, the white floor resolves into textured satellite terrain. The camera accelerates upward and backward in one continuous speed-ramped pull, making <Subject 1> appear monumental as surrounding roads, blocks, and buildings rise from the map surface.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.300, the pull-back settles over 上海. The floating search bar displays 上海 and a compact place card anchors near the lower edge. The Oriental Pearl Tower and dense riverside skyline stand beside the giant <Subject 1>, who lowers her phone and looks around with amused surprise. Her boots make firm contact with the map surface and cast matching shadows. The camera makes a short clockwise arc, then immediately accelerates sideways.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.200, a close foreground tower sweeps across the complete frame as a natural wipe. The blurred map ground streams beneath the camera and resolves into 伦敦. Big Ben and the surrounding historic city blocks rise sharply into view while the search bar updates to 伦敦. <Subject 1> reappears in the matched screen position and scale, still wearing the exact same outfit, now extending one hand as if presenting the landmark. Preserve her head height and body orientation across the wipe.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.300, the camera dives between two London buildings, which create a dark edge-to-edge foreground occlusion. It bursts out above 纽约 with a brief radial speed blur that resolves within half a second. The search bar updates to 纽约; Manhattan towers surround the giant <Subject 1>. She shifts her weight onto one leg, places one hand on her hip, and turns her face toward the moving camera. Her hair follows the turn with natural inertia and then settles.

[Shot 5] At 00:09.400, the camera whips laterally past a glass skyscraper whose reflective facade fills the frame, then the reflection transforms by a crisp match cut into the gridded map surface of 东京. Tokyo Tower rises beside <Subject 1> as the search bar updates to 东京. The camera decelerates into a gentle push-in while she lowers her presenting hand, smiles directly at the lens, and makes a small satisfied nod. Hold the complete Tokyo tableau, stable landmark, readable character, and calm final pose through 00:12.000. No duplicate character, no costume change, no facial drift, no floating feet, no broken limbs, and no stray interface text.

overall_soundscape:
A soft phone tap, one clean digital pin ping, layered map-interface tones, and synchronized low whooshes accompany each camera acceleration and building wipe. Subtle city ambience changes at each landing: distant traffic and river air in 上海, muted bells and street ambience in 伦敦, dense traffic hum in 纽约, and restrained metropolitan ambience in 东京. The opening dialogue remains clear above all effects.

non_diegetic_music:
An upbeat modern electronic travel track with a light pulsing beat begins quietly under the opening line, rises during the first pull-back, accents each city landing with a short percussive hit, and softens during the final Tokyo hold.
